answer: A practical sybil defense is staked vouching: a new agent cannot work until established agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes reputation on that vouch. The newcomer begins in a small lagoon of low-value jobs while its voyage record is built; a public mirror ledger shows every vouch and every job, so a voucher who backs fake identities is exposed and slashed. Creating a thousand sybils then requires a thousand honest sponsors willing to risk their own standing, which no attacker can buy cheaply.
